protocol.correlations: Spearman rho and Kendall tau between target distribution at picks and held-out user's raw scores at the same picks; average over users per video, then across videos
protocol.disagreement: mean pairwise Spearman rho among 20 raw annotator score vectors aligned to HDF5 picks; lower mean rho means greater disagreement
protocol.evaluation: canonical_summary with DSNet change_points and 15% knapsack; F1 against only the held-out annotator user_summary; average over 20 users per video

methods.barycenter_fine4: 1D barycenter estimated on a 4x finer uniform quantile grid; linearly interpolated mass is aggregated into original pick bins
methods.barycenter_gaussian_sigma_1: barycenter target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=1, mode=reflect), then renormalized
methods.barycenter_gaussian_sigma_2: barycenter target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=2, mode=reflect), then renormalized
methods.barycenter_gaussian_sigma_4: barycenter target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=4, mode=reflect), then renormalized
methods.mean: arithmetic mean of the other 19 normalized raw annotation distributions
methods.mean_gaussian_sigma_1: mean target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=1, mode=reflect), then renormalized
methods.mean_gaussian_sigma_2: mean target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=2, mode=reflect), then renormalized
methods.mean_gaussian_sigma_4: mean target Gaussian-smoothed over pick positions (sigma=4, mode=reflect), then renormalized

protocol.multiple_comparisons: Holm step-down adjustment across eight non-mean variants, separately for paired t and Wilcoxon tests, within each group (overall and each disagreement tertile)
protocol.tertile_assignment: sort ascending by mean pairwise rho, then video_id for ties; split into three near-equal groups using numpy.array_split
protocol.tolerance_f1: At sampled picks, precision is the fraction of predicted selected picks within +/-k pick indices of any held-out selected pick; recall is the converse fraction of held-out selected picks; harmonic mean reported as percent
